newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somali gunmen attack bus carrying Egyptian teachers.
newsitem.headline: Somali gunmen attack bus carrying Egyptian teachers.

text.p: Five gunmen armed with assault rifles opened fire on a minibus carrying a group of Egyptian teachers in north Mogadishu on Sunday, wounding the driver and two security guards.
Witnesses said the security guards on the minibus, transporting eight Egyptian teachers to a school in the area, returned fire in what appeared to be an ambush.

The gunmen managed to make off with two guns from the security guards but failed in an apparent attempt to steal the minibus. One of the Egyptian teachers was slightly wounded in the arm but the others were unhurt.
The Egyptians are teaching at the only school in the area, which is funded by Saudi Arabia.
